plan.title: Alan Turing: The Man Who Cracked the Code
plan.description: Alan Turing was a British mathematician who helped break secret wartime codes and laid the groundwork for modern computers. His story is one of brilliance, and of a hard, unfair cost.

beats.narration: He helped end a war, and he invented the idea behind your phone. Yet for years, almost nobody knew his name. Meet Alan Turing.

props.title: Alan Turing
props.subtitle: The man who cracked the code

beats.narration: Turing was a British mathematician. During the Second World War, he worked on breaking secret enemy messages, and his work helped save countless lives.
He also imagined machines that could follow any instructions. That idea became the modern computer. But he was treated cruelly by his own country. Remember him.

props.text: He imagined the computer, and changed the world.
